propositions: Interrupted compaction folds leave tracked file deletions (compact_txn renames tracked files to *.retired) that cause git merge to abort with 'Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge', stranding local ticket commits off origin.

The union merge recovery must detect this abort class by its error signature, parse the named paths, and restore tracked deletions from HEAD (via git checkout) and copy tracked modifications to quarantine before restoring, then retry the merge once.

Worktree deletions staged to the index ('D ' status) trigger the merge abort; the staged deletion must be restored non-destructively to unblock the merge while preserving any local modifications in the quarantine directory.
A genuine merge conflict (both sides commit different content to the same file) must remain unhandled by this recovery and fall back to abort-keep-local-hint-fsck-recover behavior.
